$comment: TEMPLATE — do not use directly. Copy this file to .vscode/mcp.json (which is gitignored) and edit for your machine. The Playwright MCP works as-is for web/hybrid. For mobile/mobile-hybrid, uncomment the appium-mcp block below.

playwright.$comment: Playwright MCP — Explorer's browser for web/hybrid scenarios. PINNED to 0.0.74 (not @latest) on purpose: it bundles Playwright 1.60 (Chromium build 1223), matching output/'s @playwright/test 1.60.0 so the Explorer and Executor share ONE browser build. @latest / 0.0.75 bundle a 1.61 prerelease (build 1224); Playwright then garbage-collects whichever browser the other side is not using. setup.js reads this version and installs the matching browser. To upgrade: bump this version AND output/'s @playwright/test (templates/config/package.json) to versions on the same Playwright minor line, re-run `npm run setup`, smoke-test, then commit so the whole team moves together. Keep --viewport-size aligned with output/playwright.config.ts → projects[].use.viewport.

appium-mcp.$comment: Appium MCP — version is PINNED (not @latest); @latest hits the npm registry on every Explorer invocation, adding 1-3 min cold-start. Run `npm view appium-mcp version` to check the latest, and update only when your team verifies it.
